summary.zh: 生成测试、构建与部署的 CI 工作流
summary.en: Generate workflows for tests, builds and deploys

description.zh: 提供可直接使用的 workflow 模板，覆盖测试、构建、发布与可复用工作流。适合从零搭建 CI/CD，或整理仓库里散落的流水线配置。需要仓库具备 GitHub Actions 权限。
description.en: Offers ready-to-use workflow templates for testing, building, releasing and reusable workflows. Suits setting up CI/CD from scratch or tidying scattered pipeline config. Requires GitHub Actions access on the repo.
